_comment: Hand-editable normalization tables used by pdf2schedule.py. Edit this file (not the converter) when a new PDF revision introduces a renamed subject, a new room code, or a new group.

subjects._comment: Raw subject text (after joining wrapped fragments and stripping the trailing grade letter) -> canonical name. Keys are matched case-sensitively after whitespace collapsing.

subjectShort._comment: Optional compact labels for the narrow week-grid cells. Falls back to the canonical name.

rooms._comment: Two/three-letter room codes printed in the PDF cells -> human-readable Greek name. Codes of the same shape that are really a teacher's initials (aSc prints those inside merged double-period cells) are resolved against the page's teachers instead — do not list them here.

periodTimes._comment: The school's official ΗΜΕΡΗΣΙΟ ΩΡΑΡΙΟ ΛΕΙΤΟΥΡΓΙΑΣ. aSc prints its own times in the PDF header and they are not always the ones actually rung, so these win. Remove the whole block to go back to trusting the PDF; a mismatch is always noted in the report.

groupRooms._comment: Home classroom per group, from the «Αίθουσες» sheet on the school noticeboard. Shown for every lesson of that group unless the lesson itself names a different room (a lab).

hideRooms._comment: Room codes the PDF prints but the school does not actually use. Lessons keep their subject and teacher; the room is simply not shown. Remove a code from `labels` to start showing it again.

teachers._comment: Fixes for teacher names mangled by PDF line-wrapping.

groupRules._comment: Ordered regex rules matched against the normalized group label. First match wins. Fields: grade, kind (section|track|kontra|extra), track (display name of the orientation), parent (capture group holding the class this group belongs to), name (what the picker calls it), parallel (true when the group splits the class for one subject, so its lesson replaces the class's lesson in that hour instead of colliding with it), coteach (true when nobody leaves the room and a second teacher simply joins the class for that hour — the group is never offered in the picker; its teacher is added to the class's own lesson, labelled with `name`).

groupOverrides._comment: Manual classification for labels the rules above cannot express. Same fields as a rule.

excludeGroups._comment: Groups to keep out of the app even if the PDF has a page for them — e.g. a class that does not exist and was exported by mistake. Groups with no lessons at all are hidden automatically, except «κόντρα» electives: those are real, active classes that simply may have no hour in a given week, so list one here to hide it.
